method.populationNote: Enumerated via GET /api/v1/skills with cursor paging, ordered by_active_updated (most recently updated first). Enumeration was stopped at 69,265; the registry was still returning new pages, so this is the most-recently-updated slice of the registry, not the whole of it.
method.sampling: uniform random without replacement, mulberry32 PRNG, seed 20260804, applied after a stable sort by slug so the draw is reproducible
method.resolution: Each skill was materialized as a standalone package (file manifest from the registry, real SKILL.md body) and scanned in its own root, because a published package is the unit of distribution.

caveats: These are linter findings, not adjudicated defects. Only the openclaw corpus was verified case by case.

skills-lint:schema (unknown frontmatter key) is a warning, not an error: the Agent Skills standard requires runtimes to ignore keys they do not recognise. It is reported here because it is a large share of the raw output, not because those skills are broken.

skills-lint:name counts a frontmatter name that differs from the registry slug. On ClawHub the slug is the routable identity, so a mismatch means the skill installs under a name the registry does not show. ClawHub documents that it keeps slug and stored name separate, so a share of these are deliberate.
The corpus itself (2,465 third-party SKILL.md bodies) is deliberately not republished here. Re-fetch it with the harness.
